title: Pro Tip: Have your coding agent implement a voice-to-text transcription feature to help speed up your feedback loop.
author: ratbear
selftext:
If you find yourself stopping to write down notes or keep mental tracks while testing, add a toggleable voice recording feature in your project. Have your agent set up a simple script that captures your mic input, uses a transcription service like Whisper, and directly drops the text files into a feedback folder.

This way, you can just talk through your ideas, bugs, or design critiques while playing, and your agent can review the notes later to implement changes. It saves you from breaking focus and keeps your development process much smoother.
